title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 耶穌像好撒馬利亞人一樣，在我們受傷、犯罪時來尋找、醫治並拯救我們。
lines: To save this little planet, to save you.
為了拯救這顆小小的星球，為了拯救你。
The grace of God, we didn't deserve it.
神的恩典，是我們不配得的。
Dr. Menninger, the great psychiatrist from Kansas, said, "Love is the medicine for the sickness of the world."
來自堪薩斯州的偉大精神科醫師梅寧格博士說：「愛是治療世界疾病的良藥。」
One of your former prime ministers was quoted in the press some time ago as saying he had never known a time in his whole lifetime when there was such a shortage of love.
你們的一位前總理不久前在報紙上被引述說，他一生中從未見過如此缺乏愛的時代。
I read of a woman in London, England who died at 102.
我讀到英國倫敦有一位婦女，在102歲時過世了。
For the last years of her life, she had nightly made an entry in her diary.
在她生命的最後幾年，她每天晚上都會寫日記。
And here's what her diary said day after day, and day after day.
她的日記日復一日、日復一日地這樣寫著。
"No one called today, no one loves me."
「今天沒有人打電話來，沒有人愛我。」
But I'll tell you, somebody does love you.
但我告訴你，確實有人愛你。
I don't care what your problems are, and what your tensions are, and what your pressures are, what your sins are, and what your failures are: God loves you.
我不在乎你有什麼問題，有什麼緊張，有什麼壓力，有什麼罪，有什麼失敗：神愛你。
God loves you so much that He sent His Son to the cross to endure that terrible death for you, just for you.
神如此愛你，以至於祂差遣祂的兒子上十字架，為你忍受那可怕的死亡，只為了你。
If you'd have been the only one, He would have died for you.
如果你是世界上唯一的人，祂也會為你而死。
And so, this Samaritan went to him just as Christ will come to you tonight: in your hurt, in your distress, in your failure, in your sin.
所以，這個撒馬利亞人走向他，就像基督今晚會走向你一樣：在你的傷痛、苦難、失敗和罪惡中。
He didn't just love him and leave him.
他不僅僅是愛他，然後就把他撇下。
Jesus didn't just love us and leave us, He died—He did something!
耶穌也不僅僅是愛我們，然後就把我們撇下。祂死了——祂採取了行動！
And this certain Samaritan did the same thing.
而這個撒馬利亞人也做了同樣的事。
"But God commended His love toward us in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us."
「惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候為我們死，神的愛就在此向我們顯明了。」
Do you remember reading in the paper some time ago about this doctor from Windsor, Ontario that went down to Chicago with his wife?
你還記得不久前在報紙上讀到，這位來自安大略省溫莎市的醫生和他妻子去芝加哥的事嗎？
Now I'm not sure they were on their honeymoon, but they went down to Chicago and they ate at a restaurant.
我不確定他們是否在度蜜月，但他們去了芝加哥，並在一家餐廳吃飯。
You remember that they were held up by some robbers on the street outside in a rather nice neighborhood.
你記得他們在外面一個相當不錯的社區街道上，被幾個強盜搶劫了。
The robber pulled a gun and held it at the head of his wife or his bride.
強盜拔出槍，指著他妻子或新娘的頭。
And he rushed in between, and the robber shot him and killed him.
他衝到中間，強盜開槍把他打死了。
He was saving his wife, just as the Lord Jesus Christ rushed in for His bride: those of us who are members of His body.
他在拯救他的妻子，就像主耶穌基督為祂的新娘衝鋒陷陣一樣：我們這些作為祂身體肢體的人。
He died on the cross for us because He loved us.
祂因為愛我們，而在十字架上為我們死。
Christ loved you and died for you.
"But God, who is rich in mercy, for His great love wherewith He loved us."
「然而，神既有豐富的憐憫，因祂愛我們的大愛，」
Notice this Samaritan bound up his wounds and poured in some oil.
注意，這個撒馬利亞人包裹他的傷口，並倒上了一些油。
Now the oil stands for the Holy Spirit.
You see, the Holy Spirit comes into our hearts, and convicts us of sin.
你看，聖靈進入我們的心中，叫我們為罪責備自己。
And then after we've received Christ, the Holy Spirit comes to fill our hearts and to produce the fruit of the Spirit, and to give us gifts so that we can serve Him.
然後在我們接受基督之後，聖靈來充滿我們的心，結出聖靈的果子，並賜給我們恩賜，好讓我們能服事祂。
And then he poured in the wine, and the wine with its alcoholic content was an antiseptic that would help heal the wound.
然後他倒進了酒，酒裡面的酒精成分是一種抗菌劑，有助於傷口的癒合。
And that wine, as you take it at communion, or the juice that may be served in your church, stands for the blood of Christ.
而那酒，就像你在聖餐時領受的，或者你們教會可能提供的葡萄汁一樣，代表著基督的寶血。
And the Bible says, "The blood of Jesus Christ, God's Son, cleanseth from all sin."
聖經上說：「祂兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。」
God doesn't just change us and convert us, and give us eternal life—God keeps us!
神不只是改變我們、使我們悔改歸主，並賜給我們永生——神還保守我們！
And brought him up, the Scripture says, "to an inn and took care of him."
「把他帶去，」經上說：「到客店裡去，照應他。」
And Peter said, "Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation."
彼得說：「你們這因信蒙神能力保守的人，必能得著所預備......的救恩。」
You don't have to hold on and stay in the Kingdom of God by holding on.
你不需要靠著自己苦苦抓牢來留在神的國裡。
He put him on his own beast. He had his own ambulance right there.
他把他扶上自己的牲口。他就在那裡有了自己的救護車。
And so Christ will put you in a place and give you a peace and a joy.
因此，基督也會把你安置在一個地方，賜給你平安和喜樂。
That was the first Samaritan hospital in history right there.
那正是歷史上第一家撒馬利亞人醫院。
The psalmist said concerning Christ, "He brought me up."
詩篇作者論到基督時說：「祂把我拉上來。」
It says, "He set me up, He set my feet on a rock."
經上說：「祂把我安置好，使我的腳立在磐石上。」
He held me up, He tunes me up, He'll catch me up someday.
祂扶持我，祂調整我，總有一天祂會把我接上去。
And on the day after when he left, he paid the price and said, "If he has any more needs, I'll pay when I come back."
而第二天他離開時，他付了錢並說：「如果他還有什麼需要，我回來時會還你。」
